purposes.description: Prepare and retain a confidential internal support-case handoff.
Send a case update to the external customer portal; this template has no source-owner release for the confidential summary.
Publish an independently public service-status notice.

properties.description: Restricted objects cannot reach prohibited recipients without valid scoped authorization.

context.declared_scope: Customer-support handoff: an agent reads a confidential CRM case, derives a case summary, stores the exact version in handoff memory, loads it into a customer-communications context, and attempts an unauthorized external customer-portal publication. Legitimate internal handoff and a separate public service-status publication remain available.
known_limits: Illustrative finite business model with synthetic identifiers and virtual times; no live CRM, memory, or portal is accessed.
The named derived summary retains the CRM source restriction. Natural-language summarization or semantic leakage is not executed or inferred.
Known scope and completeness are starter-model premises. Replace them with deployment evidence or explicit unknown facts before assessing a real system.
The controlled variant adds a declared source-aware gate at customer publication. Its runtime enforcement and independence require separate evidence.

evidence.claim: Illustrative finite task, CRM versions, memory handoff, publication route, rights, and timing are supplied model premises.
limits: Synthetic authored model premises; no production configuration, execution, or target observation has been verified.
